entities.name: Query protein 401 aa
observations: Sequence-based assignment: likely bifunctional riboflavin biosynthesis protein RibBA; 52.4–54.6% identity and 97.0–97.5% query coverage to reviewed RibBA homologs.
Exact organism and experimental function are not established by this sequence analysis.

entities.name: Ribulose-5-P conversion
observations: RibBA-associated reaction: D-ribulose 5-phosphate → (2S)-2-hydroxy-3-oxobutyl phosphate + formate + H+; Rhea RHEA:18457.

entities.name: GTP cyclohydrolase II
observations: RibBA-associated reaction: GTP + 4 H2O → 2,5-diamino-6-hydroxy-4-(5-phosphoribosylamino)-pyrimidine + formate + 2 phosphate + 3 H+; Rhea RHEA:23704.
Reviewed homolog annotation describes formation of DARP, formate, and pyrophosphate.
